The PKGBUILD retrieves two prebuilt EFI binaries (PreLoader.efi and HashTool.efi) from the official blog of Hansen Partnership, which is the legitimate upstream source for the Linux Foundation's UEFI secure boot system. The files are installed directly into the package directory without any modification or execution during build time. The use of `!strip` is appropriate for EFI binaries, as stripping debug symbols from such binaries can cause boot failures. All actions align with standard packaging practices for distributing signed firmware components.

The source URLs, while using plain HTTP, point to a static blog-hosted location that has been historically trusted for this project, and the strong cryptographic hashes help mitigate transport risks.
